lead_raw_text:
The structure of CoMoN₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a cell formula of Co₄Mo₄N₈ and 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co centers in octahedral environments coordinated by six N neighbors, while Mo centers have six N neighbors at distances of 2.13–2.25 Å; N centers show three geometric neighbors (one Co, two Mo). Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Co octahedra and both corner- and edge-sharing between Co octahedra and Mo six-vertex polyhedra, with the neighbor graph forming a single three-dimensional component.
